name: MAS-regulated financial institution (Singapore)
note: Task 3.3. Financial institution nouns, MAS as the regulator; CPS 230 terms become critical business services and material outsourcing arrangements (field 5, questions 1 and 2, D3, D4); examples for the authority tiers. Counsel in Singapore reviews the wording before it is used with a client.
